All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents2, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents3, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintRobot
public class Eveimear extends robocode.AdvancedRobot
Eveimear, a MicroRumble 1v1 robot (docs/kitlab.md): stop-and-go that steps once for each enemy shot until the enemy's gun has found it, then random orbit for the rest of the battle, over a GuessFactor gun on Condition waves segmented on velocity history, lateral speed and distance. Ideas taken, with thanks, from open RoboWiki bots: Epeeist and Continuation (Sheldor, RWPCL) for the damage threshold, the anti-ram term and the stick smoothing; Cotillion (Jdev) for the step length; Thorn and HedgehogGF for stop-and-go into random movement. The code is Eveimear's own and ships with its source.
